E0399

A lambda cannot write a return or error type

What

A lambda cannot write a return or error type

Why

A lambda's arrow introduces its body; return and error types come from the expected callable type

Fix

Remove the type; pass the lambda to a typed parameter or slot, or use a named `fn` for a full interface

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0399: tests/ui/lambda_after_arrow_interface.stderr.

Error [E0399]: A lambda cannot write a return or error type

  2 |     f :: (n: Int) -> Point {
    |                      ^^^^^
 Why: A lambda's arrow introduces its body; return and error types come from the expected callable type
 Fix: Remove the type; pass the lambda to a typed parameter or slot, or use a named `fn` for a full interface
